text: APPROVE: `AppendStar` reproduces all three original branches (single `*` leaves `i` unchanged, `**/` advances it by 2, trailing `**` by 1), the extracted nesting drops the caller's complexity well below 15, and the new private static helper uses the fully qualified `System.Text.StringBuilder`, so it should compile without new warnings.
